instructions: Is the tool the assistant picked the kind of tool that does what this text is asking for?

options.label: match
options.criterion: the tool's documented capability is the operation the text is asking for

options.label: mismatch
options.criterion: the tool is the wrong kind for the task (e.g. asking a read-only tool to write, or a search tool to edit)

options.label: cannot_tell
options.criterion: the text or the tool is ambiguous enough that match/mismatch cannot be decided
